records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/desire-path/README.md
records.summary: Desire Path records tool-call failures, groups repeated desires and records mappings to real tool names. An alias records a mapping; active interception has separate setup.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/desire-path/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Farchitecture.md
records.summary: Source plugins normalize raw tool payloads into shared fields; ingestion persists calls through the store interface and query commands expose patterns. The defining Go interfaces remain the authority.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/desire-path/internal%2Fcli%2Froot.go
records.summary: The dp command defines its Cobra root, database and JSON output flags, and configuration-driven store selection.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/desire-path/internal%2Fconfig%2Fconfig.go
records.summary: Configuration uses config.toml with explicit valid keys for database, source, known tools, output and store selection; legacy JSON loading is handled separately.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/desire-path/internal%2Fsource%2Fsource.go
records.summary: Source plugins expose Name, Description and Extract over raw bytes and normalized Fields; optional Installer methods govern hook setup and installed-state checks.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/desire-path/internal%2Fsignpost%2Fsignpost.go
records.summary: Optional signposting uses a configured Bobbin search endpoint, scoped result pointers and explicit payload budgets. This integration is separate from local recording.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/desire-path/AGENTS.md
records.summary: Keep dependencies minimal, use the standard testing package with table-driven cases, and use pure-Go SQLite to preserve builds without CGo.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/desire-path/README.md
records.summary: Start with the temporary-database failed-call example before installing agent hooks or sharing exports.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/desire-path/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fconfiguration.md
records.summary: Read configuration and per-command overrides before selecting a persistent database or changing capture defaults.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/desire-path/AGENTS.md
records.summary: Use the source development instructions for package layout, source plugins, dependency policy and tests.
